title: H-Town Stampede
genre: stadium rap rock anthem, trap drums, distorted power chord guitar
extra: four-on-the-floor kick and distorted guitar riff on the hooks, strip to 808 and hi-hats on the verses, gang vocal chants on the bridge

sections.name: Intro
lines: You hear that? That's the ground shaking.

sections.name: Hook
lines: STAMPEDE! Hear the horns, feel the ground
STAMPEDE! Red and blue, lock it down
H-Town, we don't bend, we don't break
Light it up, light it up, make the whole dome shake!

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Space City, we launch, call it liftoff
Third coast, steel toes, we don't kick off, we kick doors
Bayou blood in the veins, built heavy
Hurricane-tested, we been ready, stay steady

sections.name: Bridge
lines: Can't hold us, can't stop us, can't slow the charge

sections.name: Final Hook
lines: STAMPEDE! Hear the horns, feel the ground
STAMPEDE! Red and blue, lock it down
Houston, raise it up, let 'em know
Light it up, light it up, HERE WE GO!
